closeCardBrowser(DeckPicker.RESULT_DB_ERROR);\n        }\n\n        if (requestCode == EDIT_CARD && resultCode != RESULT_CANCELED) {\n            Timber.i("CardBrowser:: CardBrowser: Saving searchCards();\n            } else {\n                Timber.w("Note was added from browser and on return mSearchView == null");\n            }\n\n        }\n\n        if (requestCode == EDIT_CARD && reviewer?\n            if (getReviewerCardId() == mCurrentCardId) {\n                mReloadRequired = true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        invalidateOptionsMenu();    // maybe the availability @Override\n    public void onRestoreInstanceState(Bundle savedInstanceState) {\n        super.onRestoreInstanceState(savedInstanceState);\n        mSearchTerms = CollectionTask.cancelTask(CollectionTask.TASK_TYPE_SEARCH_CARDS);\n        CollectionTask.cancelTask(CollectionTask.TASK_TYPE_RENDER_BROWSER_QA);\n        String searchText;\n        if (mSearchTerms == null) {\n            mSearchTerms = "";\n        }\n        if (!"".equals(mSearchTerms) && (mSearchView != null)) {\n            mSearchView.setQuery(mSearchTerms, false);\n            mSearchItem.expandActionView();\n        }\n        if (mSearchTerms.contains("deck:")) {\n            searchText = mSearchTerms;\n        } else {\n            searchText = mRestrictOnDeck + mSearchTerms;\n        }\n        if (colIsOpen() && mCardsAdapter!= null) {\n            // clear the existing card list\n            mCards = new ArrayList<Map<String, String>>();\n            mCardsAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();\n            //  estimate maximum number of cards that could be visible (assuming worst-case minimum row height of 20dp)\n            int numCardsToRender = (int) Math.ceil(mCardsListView.getHeight()/\n                    TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, 20, getResources().getDisplayMetrics())) + 5;\n            // Perform database query to get all card ids\n            CollectionTask.launchCollectionTask(CollectionTask.TASK_TYPE_SEARCH_CARDS, mSearchCardsHandler, new CollectionTask.TaskData(\n                    new Object[] void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked / suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n        item.put(DECK, col.getDecks().name(c.getDid()));\n        item.put(SFLD, note.getSFld());\n    }\n\n    @CheckResult\n    private static String formatQA(String text, Context context) {\n        boolean showFilenames = AnkiDroidApp.getSharedPrefs(context).getBoolean("card_browser_show_media_filenames", false);\n        return formatQAInternal(text, showFilenames);\n    }\n\n\n    /**\n     * @param txt The text to strip HTML, comments, tags and media from\n     * @param showFileNames Whether [sound:foo.mp3] should be rendered as " foo.mp3 " or  " "\n     * @return The formatted string\n     */\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    @CheckResult\n    static String formatQAInternal(String txt, boolean showFileNames) {\n        /* Strips all formatting from the string txt for use in displaying question/answer in browser */\n        String s = txt;\n        s = s.replaceAll("<!--.*?-->", "");\n        s = s.replace("<br>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<br />", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<div>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("\\n", " ");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripSoundMedia(s) : Utils.stripSoundMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.replaceAll("\\\\[\\\\[type:[^]]+\\\\]\\\\]", "");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s) : Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.trim();\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view. int count = mToIds.length;\n                final View[] columns = new View[count];\n                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n                    columns[i] = v.findViewById(mToIds[i]);\n                }\n                v.setTag(columns);\n            } else {\n                v = convertView;\n            }\n            bindView(position, v);\n            return v;\n        }\n\n\n        private void bindView(final int position, final View v) {\n            // Draw the content in the columns\n            View[] columns = (View[]) v.getTag();\n            final Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(position);\n            for (int i = 0; i < mToIds.length; i++) {\n                TextView col = (TextView) columns[i];\n                // set font for column\n                setFont(col);\n                // set text for column\n                col.setText(card.get(mFromKeys[i]));\n            }\n            // set card\'s background color\n            final int backgroundColor = Themes.getColorFromAttr(CardBrowser.this, getColor(card));\n            v.setBackgroundColor(backgroundColor);\n            // setup checkbox to change color in multi-select mode\n            final CheckBox checkBox = (CheckBox) v.findViewById(R.id.card_checkbox);\n            // if in multi-select mode, be sure to show the checkboxes\n            if(mInMultiSelectMode) {\n                checkBox.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);\n                if (mCheckedCardPositions.contains(position)) {\n                    checkBox.setChecked(true);\n                } else {\n                    checkBox.setChecked(false);\n                }\n                // this prevents checkboxes from showing an animation from selected -> unselected when\n                // checkbox was selected, then selection mode was ended and now restarted\n                checkBox.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState();\n            } else {\n                checkBox.setChecked(false);\n                checkBox.setVisibility(View.GONE);\n            }\n            // change bg color on check changed\n            checkBox.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {\n                @Override\n                public void onClick(View view) {\n                    onCheck(position, v);\n                }\n            });\n        }\n\n        private void setFont(TextView v) {\n            // Set     public void onSaveSearch(String searchName, String searchTerms) {\n            if (TextUtils.isEmpty(searchName)) {\n                UIUtils.showThemedToast(CardBrowser.this,\n                        getString(R.string.card_browser_list_my_searches_new_search_error_empty_name), true);\n                return;\n            }\n            JSONObject savedFiltersObj = getCol().getConf().optJSONObject("savedFilters");\n            boolean should_save = false;\n            if (savedFiltersObj == null) {\n                savedFiltersObj = new JSONObject();\n                savedFiltersObj.put(searchName, searchTerms);\n                should_save = true;\n            } else if (!savedFiltersObj.has(searchName)) {\n                savedFiltersObj.put(searchName, searchTerms);\n                should_save = true;\n            } else {\n                UIUtils.showThemedToast(CardBrowser.this,\n                                        getString(R.string.card_browser_list_my_searches_new_search_error_dup), true);\n            }\n            if (should_save) {\n                getCol().getConf().put("savedFilters", savedFiltersObj);\n                getCol().flush();\n                mSearchView.setQuery("", false);\n                mMySearchesItem.setVisible(true);\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n\n ensure threadsafe iteration\n        Integer[] checkedPositions = mCheckedCardPositions.toArray(new Integer[0]);\n        long[] ids = new long[checkedPositions.length];\n        int count = 0;\n        for (int cardPosition : checkedPositions) {\n            ids[count++] = Long.valueOf(mCards.get(cardPosition).get(ID));\n        }\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private boolean hasSelectedSingleNoteId() {\n        //Heuristic to skip a large array copy\n        if (checkedCardCount() > 50) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        //copy to array to ensure threadsafe iteration\n        Integer[] checkedPositions = mCheckedCardPositions.toArray(new Integer[0]);\n        HashSet<String> notes = new HashSet<>();\n        for (Integer position : checkedPositions) {\n            String noteId = mCards.get(position).get(NOTE);\n            if (notes.add(noteId) && notes.size() > 1) {\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return notes.size() == 1;\n    }\n\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    void changeDeck(int deckPosition) {\n        long[] ids = getSelectedCardIds();\n\n        JSONObject selectedDeck = change cards to dynamic deck. Cancelling operation.");\n                displayCouldNotChangeDeck();\n                return;\n            }\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            displayCouldNotChangeDeck();\n            Timber.e(e);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        mNewDid = selectedDeck.getLong(ID);\n\n        Timber.i("Changing selected cards to deck: %d", mNewDid);\n\n        if (ids.length == 0) {\n            endMultiSelectMode();\n            mCardsAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (CardUtils.isIn(ids, getReviewerCardId())) {\n            mReloadRequired = true;\n        }\n\n        executeChangeCollectionTask(ids, mNewDid);\n    }\n\n\n    private void displayCouldNotChangeDeck() {\n        UIUtils.showThemedToast(this, private void filterByTag(List<String> selectedTags, int option) {\n        //TODO: Duplication between here and CustomStudyDialog:customStudyFromTags\n        mSearchView.setQuery("", false);\n        String tags = selectedTags.toString();\n        mSearchView.setQueryHint(getResources().getString(R.string.card_browser_tags_shown,\n                tags.substring(1, tags.length() - 1)));\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        switch (option) {\n            case 1:\n                sb.append("is:new ");\n                break;\n            case 2:\n                sb.append("is:due ");\n                break;\n            default:\n                // Logging here might be appropriate : )\n                break;\n        }\n        int i = 0;\n        for (String tag : selectedTags) {\n            if (i != 0) {\n                sb.append("or ");\n            } else {\n                sb.append("("); // Only if we really have selected tags\n            }\n            sb.append("tag:").append(tag).append(" ");\n            i++;\n        }\n        if (i > 0) {\n            sb.append(")"); // Only if we added anything to the tag list\n        }\n        mSearchTerms = sb.toString();\n        searchCards();\n    }\n\n\n    private abstract class ListenerWithProgressBar extends CollectionTask.TaskListener {\n        @Override\n        public void onPreExecute() {\n            showProgressBar();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private abstract class ListenerWithProgressBarCloseOnFalse extends ListenerWithProgressBar {\n        private String timber = null;\n\n        public ListenerWithProgressBarCloseOnFalse(String timber) {\n            this.timber = timber;\n        }\n\n        public ListenerWithProgressBarCloseOnFalse() {\n\t\t}\n\n        public void onPostExecute(CollectionTask.TaskData result) {\n            if (timber != null) {\n                Timber.d(timber);\n            }\n            if (result.getBoolean()) {\n                actualPostExecute(result);\n            } else {\n                closeCardBrowser(DeckPicker.RESULT_DB_ERROR);\n            }\n        }\n\n        protected abstract void actualPostExecute(CollectionTask.TaskData result);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @param cards Cards that were changed\n     * @param updatedCardTags Mapping note id -> updated tags\n     */\n    private void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked / suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() ==    private void bindView(final int position, final View v) {\n            // Draw the content in the columns\n            View[] columns = (View[]) v.getTag();\n            final Map<String, String> }\n            // do nothing when pref is 100% and apply scaling only once\n            if (mFontSizeScalePcent != 100 && Math.abs(mOriginalTextSize - currentSize) < 0.1) {\n                //    for (int cardPosition : checkedPositions) {\n            if (cardPosition < 0 || cardPosition >= cards.size()) {\n                Timber.w("Ignoring invalid selected position: %d", cardPosition);\n                continue;\n            }\n            String id = cards.get(cardPosition).get(ID);\n            if (id == null) {\n                continue;\n            }\n sb.append("is:due ");\n                break;\n            default:\n                // Logging here might be appropriate : )\n                break;\n        }\n        int i = 0;\n        for }\n            sb.append("tag:").append(tag).append(" ");\n            i++;\n        }\n        if (i > 0) {\n            sb.append(")"); // Only if we added anything to the tag list\n        }\n public void onPostExecute(CollectionTask.TaskData result) {\n            if (timber != null) {\n                Timber.d(timber);\n            }\n            if (result.getBoolean()) {\n void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked / suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n        item.put(DECK, col.getDecks().name(c.getDid()));\n        item.put(SFLD, note.getSFld());\n    }\n\n    @CheckResult\n    private static String formatQA(String text, Context context) {\n        boolean showFilenames = AnkiDroidApp.getSharedPrefs(context).getBoolean("card_browser_show_media_filenames", false);\n        return formatQAInternal(text, showFilenames);\n    }\n\n\n    /**\n     * @param txt The text to strip HTML, comments, tags and media from\n     * @param showFileNames Whether [sound:foo.mp3] should be rendered as " foo.mp3 " or  " "\n     * @return The formatted string\n     */\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    @CheckResult\n    static String formatQAInternal(String txt, boolean showFileNames) {\n        /* Strips all formatting from the string txt for use in displaying question/answer in browser */\n        String s = txt;\n        s = s.replaceAll("<!--.*?-->", "");\n        s = s.replace("<br>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<br />", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<div>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("\\n", " ");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripSoundMedia(s) : Utils.stripSoundMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.replaceAll("\\\\[\\\\[type:[^]]+\\\\]\\\\]", "");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s) : Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.trim();\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view. Doesn\'t delete them in model (database).\n     */\n    private void removeNotesView(Card[] cards, boolean reorderCards) {\n        List<Long> cardIds = new ArrayList<>(cards.length);\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            cardIds.add(c.getId());\n        }\n        removeNotesView(cardIds, reorderCards);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view. Doesn\'t delete them in model (database).\n     * @param reorderCards Whether to rearrange the positions of checked items (DEFECT: Currently deselects all)\n     */\n    private void removeNotesView(java.util.Collection<Long> cardsIds, boolean reorderCards) {\n        long reviewerCardId = getReviewerCardId();\n        List<Map<String, String>> oldMCards = getCards();\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(oldMCards);\n        Set<Long> idToRemove = new HashSet<Long>();\n        for (Long cardId : cardsIds) {\n            if (cardId == reviewerCardId) {\n                mReloadRequired = true;\n            }\n            if (idToPos.containsKey(cardId)) {\n                idToRemove.add(cardId);\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<Map<String, String>> newMCards = new ArrayList<Map<String, String>>();\n        for (Map<String, String> cardProperties: oldMCards) {\n            if (! idToRemove.contains(Long.parseLong(cardProperties.get(ID)))) {\n     public void onSaveSearch(String searchName, String searchTerms) {\n            if (TextUtils.isEmpty(searchName)) {\n                UIUtils.showThemedToast(CardBrowser.this,\n (#6154), so only\n        //handle the positions which are still valid.\n        List<Map<String, String>> cards = getCards();\n        List<Long> ids = new ArrayList<>(checkedPositions.length);\n        for (int cardPosition : checkedPositions) {\n            if (cardPosition < 0 || cardPosition >= cards.size()) {\n                Timber.w("Ignoring invalid selected position: %d", cardPosition);\n                continue;\n            }\n            String id = cards.get(cardPosition).get(ID);\n            if (id == null) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids.add(Long.valueOf(id));\n        }\n        long[] ret = new long[ids.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < ids.size(); i++) {\n            ret[i] = ids.get(i);\n        }\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    private boolean hasSelectedSingleNoteId() {\n        //Heuristic to skip a large array copy\n        if (checkedCardCount() > 50) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        //copy to private void filterByTag(List<String> selectedTags, int option) {\n        //TODO: Duplication between here and CustomStudyDialog:customStudyFromTags\n        mSearchView.setQuery("", false);\n sb.append("is:due ");\n                break;\n            default:\n                // Logging here might be appropriate : )\n                break;\n        }\n        int i = 0;\n        for }\n            sb.append("tag:").append(tag).append(" ");\n            i++;\n        }\n        if (i > 0) {\n            sb.append(")"); // Only if we added anything to the tag list\n        }\n void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked / suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answerif the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n        item.put(DECK, col.getDecks().name(c.getDid()));\n        item.put(SFLD, note.getSFld());\n    }\n\n    @CheckResult\n    private static String formatQA(String text, Context context) {\n        boolean showFilenames = AnkiDroidApp.getSharedPrefs(context).getBoolean("card_browser_show_media_filenames", false);\n        return formatQAInternal(text, showFilenames);\n    }\n\n\n    /**\n     * @param txt The text to strip HTML, comments, tags and media from\n     * @param showFileNames Whether [sound:foo.mp3] should be rendered as " foo.mp3 " or  " "\n     * @return The formatted string\n     */\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    @CheckResult\n    static String formatQAInternal(String txt, boolean showFileNames) {\n        /* Strips all formatting from the string txt for use in displaying question/answer in browser */\n        String s = txt;\n        s = s.replaceAll("<!--.*?-->", "");\n        s = s.replace("<br>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<br />", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<div>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("\\n", " ");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripSoundMedia(s) : Utils.stripSoundMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.replaceAll("\\\\[\\\\[type:[^]]+\\\\]\\\\]", "");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s) : Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.trim();\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view. removeNotesView(java.util.Collection<Long> cardsIds, boolean reorderCards) {\n        long reviewerCardId = getReviewerCardId();\n        List<Map<String, String>> oldMCards = getCards();\n position);\n                continue;\n            }\n            String noteId = cards.get(position).get(NOTE);\n            if (notes.add(noteId) && notes.size() > 1) {\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return notes.size() == 1;\n    }\n\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    void changeDeck(int deckPosition) {\n        long[] ids = getSelectedCardIds();\n\n = true;\n        }\n\n        executeChangeCollectionTask(ids, mNewDid);\n    }\n\n\n    private void displayCouldNotChangeDeck() {\n        UIUtils.showThemedToast(this, : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n        item.put(DECK, col.getDecks().name(c.getDid()));\n        item.put(SFLD, note.getSFld());\n    }\n\n    @CheckResult\n    private static String formatQA(String text, Context context) {\n        boolean showFilenames = AnkiDroidApp.getSharedPrefs(context).getBoolean("card_browser_show_media_filenames", false);\n        return formatQAInternal(text, showFilenames);\n    }\n\n\n    /**\n     * @param txt The text to strip HTML, comments, tags and media from\n     * @param showFileNames Whether [sound:foo.mp3] should be rendered as " foo.mp3 " or  " "\n     * @return The formatted string\n     */\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    @CheckResult\n    static String formatQAInternal(String txt, boolean showFileNames) {\n        /* Strips all formatting from the string txt for use in displaying question/answer in browser */\n        String s = txt;\n        s = s.replaceAll("<!--.*?-->", "");\n        s = s.replace("<br>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<br />", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<div>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("\\n", " ");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripSoundMedia(s) : Utils.stripSoundMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.replaceAll("\\\\[\\\\[type:[^]]+\\\\]\\\\]", "");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s) : Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.trim();\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view.     public void onSaveSearch(String searchName, String searchTerms) {\n            if (TextUtils.isEmpty(searchName)) {\n                UIUtils.showThemedToast(CardBrowser.this,\n                        getString(R.string.card_browser_list_my_searches_new_search_error_empty_name), true);\n                return;\n            }\n            JSONObject savedFiltersObj = getCol().getConf().optJSONObject("savedFilters");\n            boolean should_save = false;\n            if (savedFiltersObj == null) {\n                savedFiltersObj = new JSONObject();\n                savedFiltersObj.put(searchName, searchTerms);\n                should_save = true;\n            } else if (!savedFiltersObj.has(searchName)) {\n                savedFiltersObj.put(searchName, searchTerms);\n                should_save = true;\n            } else {\n                UIUtils.showThemedToast(CardBrowser.this,\n                                        getString(R.string.card_browser_list_my_searches_new_search_error_dup), true);\n            }\n            if (should_save) {\n                getCol().getConf().put("savedFilters", savedFiltersObj);\n                getCol().flush();\n                mSearchView.setQuery("", false);\n                mMySearchesItem.setVisible(true);\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n\n    private void onSearch() {\n        mSearchTerms = mSearchView.getQuery().toString();\n        if (mSearchTerms.length() == 0) {\n ensure threadsafe iteration\n        Integer[] checkedPositions = mCheckedCardPositions.toArray(new Integer[0]);\n        //the list of cards may have been reloaded since the selection was made (#6154), so only\n        //handle the positions which are still valid.\n        List<Map<String, String>> cards = getCards();\n        List<Long> ids = new ArrayList<>(checkedPositions.length);\n        for (int cardPosition : checkedPositions) {\n            if (cardPosition < 0 || cardPosition >= cards.size()) {\n                Timber.w("Ignoring invalid selected position: %d", cardPosition);\n                continue;\n            }\n            String id = cards.get(cardPosition).get(ID);\n            if (id == null) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids.add(Long.valueOf(id));\n        }\n        long[] ret = new long[ids.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < ids.size(); i++) {\n            ret[i] = ids.get(i);\n        }\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    private boolean hasSelectedSingleNoteId() {\n        //Heuristic to skip a large array copy\n        if (checkedCardCount() > 50) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        //copy to array to ensure threadsafe iteration\n        Integer[] checkedPositions = mCheckedCardPositions.toArray(new Integer[0]);\n        //the list of cards may have been reloaded since the selection was made (#6154), so only\n        //handle the positions which are still valid.\n        List<Map<String, String>> cards = getCards();\n        HashSet<String> notes = new HashSet<>();\n        for (Integer position : checkedPositions) {\n            if (position == null || position < 0 || position >= cards.size()) {\n                Timber.w("Ignoring invalid selected position: %s", position);\n                continue;\n            }\n            String noteId = cards.get(position).get(NOTE);\n            if (notes.add(noteId) && notes.size() > 1) {\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return notes.size() == 1;\n    }\n\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    void changeDeck(int deckPosition) {\n        long[] ids = getSelectedCardIds();\n\n Timber.w("Attempted to change cards to dynamic deck. Cancelling operation.");\n                displayCouldNotChangeDeck();\n                return;\n            }\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            displayCouldNotChangeDeck();\n            Timber.e(e);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        mNewDid = selectedDeck.getLong(ID);\n\n        Timber.i("Changing selected cards to deck: %d", mNewDid);\n\n        if (ids.length == 0) {\n = true;\n        }\n\n        executeChangeCollectionTask(ids, mNewDid);\n    }\n\n\n    private void displayCouldNotChangeDeck() {\n        UIUtils.showThemedToast(this, mSearchView.setQuery("", false);\n        String tags = selectedTags.toString();\n        mSearchView.setQueryHint(getResources().getString(R.string.card_browser_tags_shown,\n                tags.substring(1, tags.length() - 1)));\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        switch (option) {\n            case 1:\n                sb.append("is:new ");\n                break;\n            case 2:\n                sb.append("is:due ");\n                break;\n            default:\n                // Logging here might be appropriate : )\n                break;\n        }\n        int i = 0;\n        for (String tag : selectedTags) {\n            if (i != 0) {\n                sb.append("or ");\n            } else {\n                sb.append("("); // Only if we really have selected tags\n            }\n            sb.append("tag:").append(tag).append(" ");\n            i++;\n        }\n        if (i > 0) {\n            sb.append(")"); // Only if we added {\n        @Override\n        public void onPreExecute() {\n            showProgressBar();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private abstract class ListenerWithProgressBarCloseOnFalse extends ListenerWithProgressBar {\n        private String timber = null;\n\n        public ListenerWithProgressBarCloseOnFalse(String timber) {\n            this.timber = timber;\n        }\n\n        public ListenerWithProgressBarCloseOnFalse() {\n\t\t}\n\n        public void onPostExecute(CollectionTask.TaskData result) {\n            if (timber != null) {\n                Timber.d(timber);\n            }\n            if (result.getBoolean()) {\n                actualPostExecute(result);\n            } else {\n                closeCardBrowser(DeckPicker.RESULT_DB_ERROR);\n            }\n        }\n\n        protected abstract void actualPostExecute(CollectionTask.TaskData result);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @param cards Cards that were changed\n     * @param updatedCardTags Mapping note id -> updated tags\n     */\n    private void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked / suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n        item.put(DECK, col.getDecks().name(c.getDid()));\n        item.put(SFLD, note.getSFld());\n    }\n\n    @CheckResult\n    private static String formatQA(String text, Context context) {\n        boolean showFilenames = AnkiDroidApp.getSharedPrefs(context).getBoolean("card_browser_show_media_filenames", false);\n        return formatQAInternal(text, showFilenames);\n    }\n\n\n    /**\n     * @param txt The text to strip HTML, comments, tags and media from\n     * @param showFileNames Whether [sound:foo.mp3] should be rendered as " foo.mp3 " or  " "\n     * @return The formatted string\n     */\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    @CheckResult\n    static String formatQAInternal(String txt, boolean showFileNames) {\n        /* Strips all formatting from the string txt for use in displaying question/answer in browser */\n        String s = txt;\n        s = s.replaceAll("<!--.*?-->", "");\n        s = s.replace("<br>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<br />", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<div>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("\\n", " ");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s) : Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.trim();\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view. void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked/ suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n        item.put(DECK, col.getDecks().name(c.getDid()));\n        item.put(SFLD, note.getSFld());\n    }\n\n    @CheckResult\n    private static String formatQA(String text, Context context) {\n        boolean showFilenames = AnkiDroidApp.getSharedPrefs(context).getBoolean("card_browser_show_media_filenames", false);\n        return formatQAInternal(text, showFilenames);\n    }\n\n\n    /**\n     * @param txt The text to strip HTML, comments, tags and media from\n     * @param showFileNames Whether [sound:foo.mp3] should be rendered as " foo.mp3 " or  " "\n     * @return The formatted string\n     */\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    @CheckResult\n    static String formatQAInternal(String txt, boolean showFileNames) {\n        /* Strips all formatting from the string txt for use in displaying question/answer in browser */\n        String s = txt;\n        s = s.replaceAll("<!--.*?-->", "");\n        s = s.replace("<br>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<br />", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<div>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("\\n", " ");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripSoundMedia(s) : Utils.stripSoundMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.replaceAll("\\\\[\\\\[type:[^]]+\\\\]\\\\]", "");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s) : Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.trim();\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view. Doesn\'t delete them in model (database).\n     */\n    private void removeNotesView(Card[] cards, boolean reorderCards) {\n        List<Long> cardIds = new ArrayList<>(cards.length);\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            cardIds.add(c.getId());\n        }\n        removeNotesView(cardIds, reorderCards);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view. Doesn\'t delete them in model (database).\n     * @param reorderCards Whether to rearrange the positions of checked items (DEFECT: Currently deselects all)\n     */\n    private void CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        AbstractSched sched = col.getSched();\n        Object[] data = params[0].getObjArray();\n        Card card = (Card) data[0];\n        Collection.DismissType type = (Collection.DismissType) data[1];\n        Note note = card.note();\n        try {\n            col.getDb().getDatabase().beginTransaction();\n            try {\n                sched.deferReset();\n                switch (type) {\n                    case BURY_CARD:\n                        // collect undo information\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] { col.getDirty(), note.cards(), card.getId() });\n                        // then bury\n                        sched.buryCards(new long[] { card.getId() });\n                        break;\n                    case BURY_NOTE:\n                        // collect undo information\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] { col.getDirty(), note.cards(), card.getId() });\n                        // then bury\n                        sched.buryNote(note.getId());\n                        break;\n                    case SUSPEND_CARD:\n                        // collect undo information\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] { card });\n                        // suspend card\n                        if (card.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED) {\n                            sched.unsuspendCards(new long[] { card.getId() });\n                        } else {\n                            sched.suspendCards(new long[] { card.getId() });\n                        }\n                        break;\n                    case SUSPEND_NOTE: {\n                        // collect undo information\n                        ArrayList<Card> cards = note.cards();\n                        long[] cids = new long[cards.size()];\n                        for (int i = 0; i < cards.size(); i++) {\n                            cids[i] = cards.get(i).getId();\n                        }\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] { cards, card.getId() });\n                        // suspend note\n                        sched.suspendCards(cids);\n                        break;\n                    }\n\n                    case DELETE_NOTE: {\n                        // collect undo information\n col.remNotes(new long[] { note.getId() });\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n                // With sHadCardQueue set, getCard() resets the scheduler prior to getting the next card\n                publishProgress(new TaskData(col.getSched().getCard(), 0));\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().setTransactionSuccessful();\n            } finally {\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().endTransaction();\n            }\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "doInBackgroundDismissNote - RuntimeException on dismissing note, dismiss type %s", type);\n            AnkiDroidApp.sendExceptionReport(e, "doInBackgroundDismissNote");\n            return new TaskData(false);\n        }\n        return new TaskData(true);\n    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundDismissNotes(TaskData... params) {\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        AbstractSched sched = col.getSched();\n        Object[] data = params[0].getObjArray();\n        long[] cardIds = (long[]) data[0];\n        // query cards\n        Card[] cards = new Card[cardIds.length];\n        for (int i = 0; i < cardIds.length; i++) {\n            cards[i] = col.getCard(cardIds[i]);\n        }\n\n        Collection.DismissType type = (Collection.DismissType) data[1];\n        try {\n            col.getDb().getDatabase().beginTransaction();\n            try {\n                switch (type) {\n                    case SUSPEND_CARD_MULTI: {\n                        // collect undo information\n                        long[] cids = new long[cards.length];\n                        boolean[] originalSuspended = new boolean[cards.length];\n                        boolean hasUnsuspended =      if (card.getQueue() != Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED) {\n                                hasUnsuspended = true;\n                                originalSuspended[i] = false;\n                            } else {\n                                originalSuspended[i] = true;\n                            }\n                        }\n\n                        // if at least one card is unsuspended -> suspend all\n                        // otherwise unsuspend all\n                        if (hasUnsuspended) {\n                            sched.suspendCards(cids);\n                        } else {\n                            sched.unsuspendCards(cids);\n                        }\n\n                        // mark undo for all at once\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] {cards, originalSuspended});\n\n                        // reload cards because they\'ll be passed back to caller\n                        for (Card c : cards) {\n                            c.load();\n                        }\n\n                        sched.deferReset();\n                        break;\n                    }\n\n                    case FLAG: {\n                        int flag = (Integer) data[2];\n                        col.setUserFlag(flag, cardIds);\n                        for (Card c : cards) {\n                            c.load();\n                        }\n                        break;\n                    }\n\n                    case MARK_NOTE_MULTI: {\n                        Set<Note> notes = CardUtils.getNotes(Arrays.asList(cards));\n                        // collect undo information\n                        List<Note> originalMarked = new ArrayList<>();\n                        List<Note> originalUnmarked = new ArrayList<>();\n\n                        for (Note n : notes) {\n                            if (n.hasTag("marked"))\n                                originalMarked.add(n);\n                            else\n                                originalUnmarked.add(n);\n                        }\n\n                        CardUtils.markAll(new ArrayList<>(notes), !originalUnmarked.isEmpty());\n\n                        // mark undo for all at once\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] {originalMarked, originalUnmarked});\n\n                        // reload cards because they\'ll be passed back to caller\n                        for (Card c : cards) {\n                            c.load();\n                        }\n\n                        break;\n                    }\n\n                    case DELETE_NOTE_MULTI: {\n                        // list of all ids to pass to remNotes method.\n                        // Need Set (-> unique) so we don\'t pass duplicates to col.remNotes()\n                    long[] uniqueNoteIds = new long[notes.size()];\n                        Note[] notesArr = notes.toArray(new Note[notes.size()]);\n                        int count = 0;\n                        for (Note note : notes) {\n                            uniqueNoteIds[count] = note.getId();\n                            count++;\n                        }\n\n                        col.markUndo(type, new Object[] {notesArr, allCards});\n\n                        col.remNotes(uniqueNoteIds);\n                        sched.deferReset();\n                        // pass back all cards because they can\'t be retrieved anymore by the caller (since the note is deleted)\n                        publishProgress(new TaskData(allCards.toArray(new Card[allCards.size()])));\n                        break;\n                    }\n\n                    case CHANGE_DECK_MULTI: {\n                        long newDid = (long) data[2];\n\n                        Timber.i("Changing %d cards to deck: \'%d\'", cards.length, newDid);\n                        JSONObject deckData = col.getDecks().get(newDid);\n\n                        if (Decks.isDynamic(deckData)) {\n                            //#5932 - can\'t change to a dynamic deck. Use "Rebuild"\n                            Timber.w("Attempted to move to dynamic deck.            try {\n                            long actualId = deckData.getLong("id");\n                            if (actualId != newDid) {\n                                Timber.w("Attempted to RESCHEDULE_CARDS:\n                    case REPOSITION_CARDS:\n                    case RESET_CARDS: {\n                        // collect undo information, sensitive to memory pressure, same for all 3 cases\n                        try {\n                            Timber.d("Saving undo information of type %s on %d cards", type, cards.length);\n                            col.markUndo(type, new         } finally {\n                col.getDb().getDatabase().endTransaction();\n            }\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "doInBackgroundSuspendCard - deepCopyCardArray(Card[] originals) throws CancellationException {\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(AnkiDroidApp.getInstance());\n        Card[] copies = new Card[originals.length];\n        for (int i = 0; i < originals.length; i++) {\n            if (isCancelled()) {\n                Timber.i("Cancelled during deep copy, probably memory pressure?");\n                throw new CancellationException("Cancelled during deep copy");\n            }\n\n            // TODO: the performance-naive implementation loads from database instead of working in memory\n            // the high performance version would implement .clone() on Card and test it well\n            copies[i] = new Card(col, originals[i].getId());\n        }\n        return copies;\n    }\n\n\n    private TaskData doInBackgroundUndo(TaskData... params) {\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        AbstractSched sched = col.getSched();\n        try {\n            col.getDb().getDatabase().beginTransaction();\n            Card newCard = null;\n            try {\n                long cid = col.undo();\n                if (cid == 0) {\n                    // /* card schedule change undone, reset and get\n                    // new card */\n                    Timber.d("Single card non-review change undo succeeded");\n                    col.reset();\n                    newCard = sched.getCard();\n                } else if (cid > 0) {\n                    // a review was undone,\n                     /* card review undone, set up to review that card again */\n                    Timber.d("Single card review undo succeeded");\n                    newCard = col.getCard(cid);\n                    newCard.startTimer();\n                    col.reset();\n                    col.getSched().decrementCounts(newCard);\n                    sched.deferReset();\n                } else {\n                    // cid < 0\n                    /* multi-card action undone, no action to take here */\n                    Timber.d("Multi-select undo succeeded");\n                }\n                // TODO: handle leech undoing properly\n col.getDb().getDatabase().endTransaction();\n            }\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            Timber.e(e, "doInBackgroundUndo - RuntimeException on undoing");\n Function<Position, BrowserCard>)\n        Timber.d("doInBackgroundRenderBrowserQA");\n        Collection col = CollectionHelper.getInstance().getCol(mContext);\n        List<Map<String, String>> cards = (List<Map<String, String>>) params[0].getObjArray()[0];\n        Integer startPos = (Integer) params[0].getObjArray()[1];\n        Integer n = (Integer) params[0].getObjArray()[2];\n\n        List<Long> invalidCardIds = new ArrayList<>();\n        // for each specified card in the browser list\n        for (int i = startPos; i < startPos + n; i++) {\n            // Stop if cancelled\n            if (isCancelled()) {\n                Timber.d("doInBackgroundRenderBrowserQA was aborted");\n                return null;\n            }\n            if (i < 0 || i >= cards.size()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card;\n            try {\n                card = cards.get(i);\n            }\n            catch (IndexOutOfBoundsException e) {\n                //even though we test against card.size() above, there\'s still a race condition\n                //We might be able to optimise this to return here.                //process\n                Timber.e(e, "Could not process card \'%s\' - skipping and removing from sight", maybeCardId);\n                invalidCardIds.add(cardId);\n                continue;\n            }\n            // Update item\n            CardBrowser.updateSearchItemQA(mContext, card, c, col);\n            float progress = (float) i / n * 100;\n requestCode, resultCode);\n        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);\n\n        if (resultCode == DeckPicker.RESULT_DB_ERROR) {\n            closeCardBrowser(DeckPicker.RESULT_DB_ERROR);\n        }\n\n        if (requestCode == EDIT_CARD && resultCode != RESULT_CANCELED) {\n            Timber.i("CardBrowser:: CardBrowser: Saving card...");\n            CollectionTask.launchCollectionTask(CollectionTask.TASK_TYPE_UPDATE_NOTE, mUpdateCardHandler,\n                    new CollectionTask.TaskData(sCardBrowserCard, false));\n        } else if (requestCode == ADD_NOTE && resultCode == RESULT_OK) {\n            if (mSearchView != null) {\n                mSearchTerms = mSearchView.getQuery().toString();\n                searchCards();\n            } else {\n                Timber.w("Note was added from browser and on return mSearchView == null");\n            }\n\n        }\n\n        if (requestCode == EDIT_CARD &&  data!=null && data.hasExtra("reloadRequired")) {\n            // if reloadRequired flag was sent from note editor then reload card list\n            searchCards();\n            // in use by reviewer?\n            if (getReviewerCardId() == mCurrentCardId) {\n                mReloadRequired = true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        invalidateOptionsMenu();    // maybe the availability of undo changed\n    }\n\n\n    // We spawn CollectionTasks that may create memory pressure, this transmits it so polling isCancelled sees the pressure\n    @Override\n    public void onTrimMemory(int void updateCardsInList(List<Card> cards, Map<Long, String> updatedCardTags) {\n        Map<Long, Integer> idToPos = getPositionMap(getCards());\n        for (Card c : cards) {\n            Note note = c.note();\n            // get position in the mCards search results HashMap\n            int pos = idToPos.containsKey(c.getId()) ? idToPos.get(c.getId()) : -1;\n            if (pos < 0 || pos >= getCardCount()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, String> card = getCards().get(pos);\n            // update tags\n            card.put(MARKED, (c.note().hasTag("marked")) ? "marked" : null);\n            if (updatedCardTags != null) {\n                card.put(TAGS, updatedCardTags.get(c.getNid()));\n            }\n            // update sfld\n            String sfld = note.getSFld();\n            card.put(SFLD, sfld);\n            // update Q & A etc\n            updateSearchItemQA(getBaseContext(), card, c, getCol());\n            // update deck\n            String deckName;\n            deckName = getCol().getDecks().get(c.getDid()).getString("name");\n            card.put(DECK, deckName);\n            // update flags (marked / suspended / etc) which determine color\n            card.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n            card.put(FLAGS, (new Integer(c.getUserFlag())).toString());\n        }\n\n        updateList();\n    }\n\n    private CollectionTask.TaskListener mUpdateCardHandler = updateSearchItemQA(Context context, Map<String, String> item, Card c, Collection col) {\n        // render question and answer\n        Map<String, String> qa = c._getQA(true, true);\n        // Render full question / answer if the bafmt (i.e. "browser appearance") setting forced blank result\n        if ("".equals(qa.get("q")) || "".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n            HashMap<String, String> qaFull = c._getQA(true, false);\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("q"))) {\n                qa.put("q", qaFull.get("q"));\n            }\n            if ("".equals(qa.get("a"))) {\n                qa.put("a", qaFull.get("a"));\n            }\n        }\n        // update the original hash map to include rendered question & answer\n        String q = qa.get("q");\n        String a = qa.get("a");\n        // remove the question from the start of the answer if it exists\n        if (a.startsWith(q)) {\n            a = a.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(q), "");\n        }\n        // put all of the fields in except for those that have already been pulled out straight from the\n        // database\n        item.put(ANSWER, formatQA(a, context));\n        item.put(CARD, c.template().optString("name"));\n        item.put(DUE, c.getDueString());\n        if (c.getType() == Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW) {\n            item.put(EASE, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_ease_new_card));\n        } else {\n            item.put(EASE, (c.getFactor()/10)+"%");\n        }\n\n        Note note = c.note();\n        item.put(CHANGED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(c.getMod()));\n        item.put(CREATED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromMs(note.getId()));\n        item.put(EDITED, LanguageUtil.getShortDateFormatFromS(note.getMod()));\n        // interval\n        switch (c.getType()) {\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_NEW:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_new_card));\n                break;\n            case Consts.CARD_TYPE_LRN :\n                item.put(INTERVAL, context.getString(R.string.card_browser_interval_learning_card));\n                break;\n            default:\n                item.put(INTERVAL, Utils.roundedTimeSpanUnformatted(context, c.getIvl()*86400));\n                break;\n        }\n        item.put(LAPSES, Integer.toString(c.getLapses()));\n        item.put(NOTE, c.model().optString("name"));\n        item.put(QUESTION, formatQA(q, context));\n        item.put(REVIEWS, Integer.toString(c.getReps()));\n        String tags = note.stringTags();\n        item.put(TAGS, tags);\n        item.put(MARKED, (sMarkedPattern.matcher(item.get(TAGS)).matches())?"marked": null);\n        item.put(FLAGS, (Integer.toString(c.getUserFlag())));\n        item.put(SUSPENDED, c.getQueue() == Consts.QUEUE_TYPE_SUSPENDED ? "True": "False");\n        item.put(DECK, col.getDecks().name(c.getDid()));\n        item.put(SFLD, note.getSFld());\n    }\n\n    @CheckResult\n    private static String formatQA(String text, Context context) {\n        boolean showFilenames = AnkiDroidApp.getSharedPrefs(context).getBoolean("card_browser_show_media_filenames", false);\n        return formatQAInternal(text, showFilenames);\n    }\n\n\n    /**\n     * @param txt The text to strip HTML, comments, tags and media from\n     * @param showFileNames Whether [sound:foo.mp3] should be rendered as " foo.mp3 " or  " "\n     * @return The formatted string\n     */\n    @VisibleForTesting\n    @CheckResult\n    static String formatQAInternal(String txt, boolean showFileNames) {\n        /* Strips all formatting from the string txt for use in displaying question/answer in browser */\n        String s = txt;\n        s = s.replaceAll("<!--.*?-->", "");\n        s = s.replace("<br>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<br />", " ");\n        s = s.replace("<div>", " ");\n        s = s.replace("\\n", " ");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripSoundMedia(s) : Utils.stripSoundMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.replaceAll("\\\\[\\\\[type:[^]]+\\\\]\\\\]", "");\n        s = showFileNames ? Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s) : Utils.stripHTMLMedia(s, " ");\n        s = s.trim();\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Removes cards from view.
